agenda_text:
BELMONT SHORE PARKING AND BUSINESS
  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 19, 2024
  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

Matthew Peterson, Chair  David Link, Commissioner
Jann Kronick-Gath, Vice Chair  Jodi Meade, Commissioner
Deborah Castro, Commissioner  Aaron Tofani, Commissioner

MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS OR
  EMAIL COMMENTS TO TERI.LUCE@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54892  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Belmont Shore Parking and
  Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission meeting of Thursday, July 18,
  2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54893  Recommendation to recieve and file a Long Beach Public Works financial report
  discussing revenues during the period ending July 31, 2024 and August 31, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54894  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Transit Employee Bus Pass
  Program Status for July 2024 and August 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-54895  Recommendation to receive status updates on Conservation Corps of Long
  Beach’s work in the Belmont Shore area, including responses to requests for
  assistance, for July 2024 and August 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-54896  Recommendation to receive updates regarding the health of the trees along
  Belmont Shore Business District.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

the meeting.
